question: Should maintainers close this stale conflicting PR and keep the canonical issue open for a fresh fix, or ask the contributor to refresh this branch with proof?
rationale: The bug remains valid, but this PR no longer applies cleanly and ClawSweeper should not auto-close the same-author issue/PR pair without maintainer intent.

options.title: Close and replace through the canonical issue
options.body: Close this stale PR, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46894 open, and land a fresh narrow fix against current main with real Control UI proof.

options.title: Ask contributor to refresh
options.body: Leave this PR open only if the contributor is expected to port it to current paths, align `/model status` and `/model list`, and add real behavior proof.

options.title: Accept bare-summary behavior deliberately
options.body: Maintainers may choose the simpler semantics, but that should come with explicit docs/shared-command alignment before merge.

recommendation.title: Close and replace through the canonical issue
recommendation.body: Close this stale PR, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46894 open, and land a fresh narrow fix against current main with real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI model-command history and CODEOWNERS make this the best available routing owner for the close-or-replace decision.
